Azure Backup policy:
  Frequency: Daily, 9:00 PM
  Retention: Daily points kept 30 days
             Weekly points kept 12 weeks
             Monthly points kept 12 months

AWS Backup plan:
  Rule: Daily at 02:00 UTC
  Lifecycle: Cold storage after 30 days, delete after 365
caption: Both tools turn "backups run at least every N hours" into a schedule nobody has to remember.

steps.label: Retention

steps.label: Daily
steps.sub: kept for a week — fine-grained, recent recovery points

steps.label: Weekly
steps.sub: kept for a month — coarser, older history

steps.label: Monthly
steps.sub: kept for a year — same span, far less storage
